subject: info-ds
title: (R)INFO.DS.------C.CONT.
description: Chart on book p. 313 (WI-29). INFO-DS (information dissemination) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; C-CONT (composite continuance) is the partner. From the subject: T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) and RE-ST (restructuralism). From T-C-IMP: PHY-U-P (physical universe particular) and COS-P (cosmic particulars). From PHY-U-P: PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics). From COS-P: HI-P (high purpose). From HI-P: TH-CONT-DY (thrust continuance dynamics) and TRS (transition).
